as the community grows, the spotlight becomes more valuable

basically a free 24hr billboard on a high traffic site while helping people discover accounts they probably never would have found otherwise

• capture the current portrait directly from the site
• post it to X in a few clicks
• every new person changes the image

more PFPs → more portraits shared → more timeline exposure → more people join → the portrait grows again

that’s the flywheel

designed to give people a reason to:
• participate

• stay on the grid
